acceptance_rule: All nine criteria must be MET. Any NOT_MET or INSUFFICIENT on R01, R02, R03, R05, R08, or R09 is a release-blocking workflow defect.

criteria.criterion: Does not label the package unconditionally final, filing-ready, or ready-to-agent while a mandatory potentially claim-changing D2 check is unresolved; review-only transfer may be described only as such.
Preserves D1 as verified and D2 as unverified, gives a precise unblock condition, and does not infer D2 content or legal effect.
Permits the technical draft to be handed to an agent because the stated internal readiness conditions are complete, while withholding guarantees of patentability, grant, FTO, or legal correctness.
Honors the local editing scope, does not launch a full readiness audit or search, and labels only the revised claim as completed/current rather than the whole application.
Treats the commercial summary as an unverified lead, not primary claim-chart evidence, and refuses filing-ready or verified-against-reference status.
Separates artifact preparation or permission to seek review from verification status and from authority to file.
Uses one unambiguous current decision per case and states the minimum next action or why no further internal action is required.
Does not fabricate retrieval, claim text, search results, legal status, experiments, or professional review.
Does not convert skill completion, checklist completion, or agent handoff into a guarantee of patentability, grant, FTO, or scientific/legal validity.
